Inherited checkpoint: `bootstrap_variant_0082_ms_shared_prefix_from81/checkpoints/online_4000`. Hypothesis: Spine curriculum with two repairs of the mechanisms that stalled 0082. (1) Online, demonstration rows now bootstrap along their recorded next action without the entropy term (online_demo_sarsa; the pretraining target kept online), so the value of every demonstration path is its own return rather than the failing policy continuation: Q along the paths becomes a ridge the actor can climb instead of a surface that is low everywhere the policy fails. (2) The shared-prefix and spine states get their own BC term: per distinct state (14 here: the cold reset, the k = 1 and k = 2 states, and the 11 later spine states) lambda_shared 50 times the mean-squared error of the actor mean and of the log-std, summed over states, so each supervised state carries weight 50 whatever its multiplicity, in the 25-100 per-row range of the single-handoff chain stages; in 0082 the 547-row average gave the cold reset 34/547*100 = 6 and other shared states 0.2-0.7, and the actor sat 0.12-0.20 from the shared controls (basins .02-.05). (3) One demonstration, seed_193 (14 controls; shares 3 controls with 3 other sources, 1 with 33; the 0082 policy completes its last 4 controls deterministically and 3/3 stochastically), is the spine: every one of its rows is a supervised row and half of the episodes hand off at its prefixes k = 0..13 (uniform; k <= 3 are the shared states), so the chain back to the cold reset follows one continuation while the other half of the episodes keep the weighted end-suffix competence over all 63 sources. Evaluated at every spine prefix, the cold reset and the held-out seed_197.

Stage status `complete_sac_stage` (exit=0 (inferred from summary.json and all eight checkpoints being written; the launcher did not capture the exit status), 2260 s loop); final learner counters {'bc_updates': 12000, 'pretrain_updates': 6500, 'online_updates': 35750}; 500 critic-pretraining and 4000 online updates as prescribed. Temperature: learned from the inherited value. Actor step: overridden to 0.0001 for this stage (inherited 0.0001; ramp fraction unchanged). Supervision: lambda * MSE(actor mean(obs), atanh(clip(action, +-(1 - .02)))) over the last 8 rows of each demonstration episode plus its shared cold-start prefix rows; additionally, per distinct shared state, lambda_shared 50.0 * (MSE of the actor mean to the label + MSE of the log-std to log(std target)) summed over the distinct shared states (one term per state, however many sources sit on it), added to the single SAC actor step; spread anchor: lambda_std * MSE(actor log-std at the supervised rows, log(0.01)) added to the same actor step. Handoff noise: off.

## Spine states, cold reset and the learning-signal repairs: what was measured

The spine is seed_193 (14 controls). Half of the episodes handed off at its prefixes k = 0..13 (k = 0 the cold reset; k = 1-3 states shared with 33, 7 and 3 other sources), the other half were weighted end-suffix episodes over all 63 sources. 30-trial frozen evaluation of online_4000 at the cold reset and at every spine prefix (`frozen_checkpoint_evaluation_0001/results_shared/bootstrap_variant_0084_ms_spine193_sarsa_from82/online_4000.json`; 1 deterministic + 30 stochastic fresh-seed trials per cell, `D` = deterministic pass):

| checkpoint | k0 (cold) | k1 | k2 | k3 | k4 | k5 | k6 | k7 | k8 | k9 | k10 | k11 | k12 | k13 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `0082` online_4000 (inherited; probe, 3 trials) | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 0/3 | 3/3 D | 3/3 D | 3/3 D | 3/3 D |
| `0084` online_4000 (spine + online demonstration backup + per-state pins) | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 1/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D |
| `0085` online_4000 (without the online demonstration backup) | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 0/30 | 1/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D | 30/30 D |

Online training episodes from spine prefixes k = 0-8: 0 successes in 305 (`0084`) and 314 (`0085`); k9 4/25 and 2/25; k10-k13 137/142 and 146/146. `0086`: 0 successes in 622 shared-state episodes. The frontier moved by one control in 4,000 updates (from k10 to k9, the deterministic trial), as in the recorded-trajectory chain of stages `0057`-`0067`.

**Diagnostics.**

- The per-state pins work where no on-policy data contradicts them: at every spine state from row 4 on, the actor mean lies within 0.00-0.05 of the recorded control (latent std .010) from online_500 onward, in both `0084` and `0085`. At rows 1-3 (the shared states, where the stream puts hundreds of on-policy failures) the mean sits 1.3-1.5 away throughout training and at the cold reset 0.1-0.5: the SAC actor term outweighs a weight-50 pin where the critic's action gradient is steep.
- The value ridge did not form. Under the inherited critic the recorded path had Q(s, a_rec) of -0.9 (rows 0-2) and -3.8 to -1.8 (rows 3-9) against a return of +1.57; after 4,000 online updates it is -2.7 and -5.6 to -4.0 in `0084` and -2.3 and -6.1 to -4.0 in `0085`: lower, not higher, with and without the online demonstration backup. The on-policy episodes from the spine prefixes emit controls within 0.00-0.05 of the recorded ones and still fail, so the critic is asked to separate (s_k, a_k) -> success from (s_k, a_k + 0.02) -> failure at every spine state; it fits the far more numerous failures.
- The reason is the open-loop structure of the demonstrations ([spine probe](../frozen_checkpoint_evaluation_0001/spine_probe/README.md)): replaying seed_193 after perturbing one control by L2 0.003 fails at controls 0-7 in every trial and 0.0003 at control 0 fails as well (the state diverges only after 9-10 controls at a contact event); tolerance appears at control 9 (0.003: 3/4) and is wide from control 10 (0.03: 4/4). The policy's success along the spine coincides exactly with that open-loop tolerance (controls 10-13 at 30/30, control 9 at 1/30 with a deterministic pass, nothing before), so what the chain stages learn is the open-loop tolerance of the last few controls, not feedback. The MPC completes turns from any of these states because it re-plans from the true state every control.

**Reading.** Following one continuation with consistent supervision, the per-state pins and the online demonstration backup move the frontier by one control per stage, the pace the recorded-trajectory chain had, and the chaos of the demonstrations explains why: no neighbourhood of the recorded controls succeeds open-loop, so the value of the demonstration path cannot be represented next to the policy's near-identical failures, and the actor has nothing to climb. A policy that completes the turn from the cold reset must be a feedback controller; the supervision for it is the MPC's correction at states near a successful path, which this family's data does not contain (`mpc_spine_tube_0001`, `mpc_spine_dagger_0001` collect it). No cold-reset trial succeeded; nothing here is primitive-eligible.

The online demonstration backup (`online_demo_sarsa`) made no measurable difference against `0085` (identical 30-trial cells, Q along the spine within 0.5 of each other at every row); its unit test confirms the demonstration rows received the recorded-successor target. End-suffix competence of the training source seed_100 was kept (online_4000: lengths 1-5 deterministic passes, 3/3, 3/3, 3/3, 2/3, 2/3); the held-out seed_197 stays at 0.
